overview.description: The Sequoia Global Value ETF (SFGV) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed fund that broadly invest in equity securities across all market capitalizations from around the world, including emerging markets. SFGV was launched on Jan 18, 2024 and is issued by CCM.
